# Alex Merced Media

> AlexMercedMedia.com is the central media hub for content created by Alex Merced — Head of Developer Relations at Dremio, author, podcaster, and YouTuber. It aggregates his work across data engineering, Apache Iceberg, AI, developer relations, and libertarian philosophy.

Alex Merced is an instructional advocate helping developers master the Data Lakehouse ecosystem. His expertise spans Apache Iceberg, Dremio, open-source software, agentic analytics, JavaScript, Python, Rust, Golang, and libertarian economics and philosophy.

## About

- [Alex Merced Media — Homepage](https://alexmercedmedia.com): Central hub aggregating Alex Merced's blogs, videos, podcasts, and books.

## Videos

- [Latest Videos](https://alexmercedmedia.com/videos): Tutorials, talks, and tech deep dives across Alex's YouTube channels.

- [Understanding Data with Alex Merced (@AlexMercedData)](https://www.youtube.com/@AlexMercedData): Data Engineering, Lakehouse, and Apache Iceberg crash courses.
